title: Derived tensor-Hom adjunction for a perfect complex
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let A and I be perfect objects of D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex], and let E be any object of D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. The derived tensor-Hom adjunction [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] gives a natural bijection Hom_{D(O_X)}(I,RHom(A,E))\cong Hom_{D(O_X)}(A\otimes^L I,E); under it a morphism I\to RHom(A,E) corresponds to a morphism A\otimes^L I\to E.
